MP-ASH-Viewer 1.4.0: Active Session History for Oracle (including Standard Edition, without the Diagnostics Pack) and PostgreSQL.

**Download** `MP-ASH-Viewer-v1.4.0.zip`, unzip it and follow `README.txt` (Java 11+ with graphics, the JDBC driver in `lib/`, then `exec_ashv.sh` or `exec_ashv.bat`).

New in this version:

- **Hide background** (Oracle) next to the Top Activity, History and Compare charts: hides the background processes (DBWn, LGWR, MMON...) in every chart and table.
- **Hide (empty)** next to "Group by" and "Compare by": leaves out the "(empty)" value of the grouped column (sessions without MODULE, ACTION...).
- **PL/SQL caller** (OracleSE): group, compare or filter by `PLSQL_ENTRY` to see the SQLs run inside one procedure as one block, like the "Top Level SQL" of Enterprise Manager, shown as `OWNER.PACKAGE.PROCEDURE`. New grant: `dba_procedures` (see `ashv-grants.sql`).

Fixed:

- OracleSE collection: `TIME_WAITED` was a count of logons (`v$sesstat` statistic# 12), not a time, and its join was the most expensive part of the query run every second. Now it is the time of the current wait (0 on CPU), and the query takes about half the time. The `v_$sesstat` grant is no longer needed.

All changes: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/mpontes-stack/MP-ASH-Viewer/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
